# Durgesh Chavda — Chartered Accountant & Virtual CFO

> CA Durgesh Chavda is a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) and Virtual CFO based in Ahmedabad, India, with offices in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Rajkot and Dubai. He advises VC-backed startups, founders and family offices on fundraising, investor reporting, FEMA/RBI compliance (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, ODI), GST and direct tax, valuation and cross-border structuring (US Delaware, Singapore, DIFC, Mauritius). He led and closed a USD 3.75M Pre-Series A for AI EdTech company Stimuler, and is Managing Partner at Finvy.

Contact: hello@durgeshchavda.com · WhatsApp/phone +91 78018 87130 · LinkedIn https://linkedin.com/in/ca-durgesh-chavda-bb08a6b0

## Guides

- [Delaware Flip for Indian Startups: Is a US Holdco Worth It?](https://www.durgeshchavda.com/insights/delaware-flip-for-indian-startups/): Should your Indian startup flip to a US Delaware holdco? How flips work, FEMA/ODI rules, tax on the share swap, POEM risks and the reverse-flip trend.
- [FC-GPR Filing Guide: 30-Day Deadline & Documents (2026)](https://www.durgeshchavda.com/insights/fc-gpr-filing-guide/): FC-GPR filing guide for startups raising foreign investment: 30-day deadline, documents, FEMA valuation, FIRMS portal steps and late submission fees.
- [FC-TRS Filing Guide: Share Transfers with Non-Residents](https://www.durgeshchavda.com/insights/fc-trs-filing-guide/): FC-TRS explained: when it applies, who files, the 60-day deadline, FEMA pricing rules, deferred consideration, documents and the FIRMS process.
- [Virtual CFO vs Full-Time CFO: Which Does Your Startup Need?](https://www.durgeshchavda.com/insights/virtual-cfo-vs-full-time-cfo/): Virtual CFO vs full-time CFO: what each covers, signs you have outgrown your accountant, when to hire full-time and how to choose a Virtual CFO.
